[RS_SOMEIP_00040]
SOME/IP protocol shall support providing the length of a serialized data
element in the payload
[RS_SOMEIP_00041]
SOME/IP protocol shall provide support of multiple versions of the protocol
[RS_SOMEIP_00042]
SOME/IP protocol shall support unicast and multicast based event
communication
[RS_SOMEIP_00050]
SOME/IP protocol shall support serialization of extensible data structs
[RS_SOMEIP_00051]
SOME/IP protocol shall provide support for segmented transmission of large
data
